strings.account.sheet.saveIntro: Save your progress so it rides with you to any phone. Same game, same handle, same clout.
strings.account.sheet.loginIntro: Log in to get your saved game on this device.
strings.account.sheet.loginSwitch: This device switches to your account. If both have progress, you pick which one to keep.
strings.account.sheet.warning: Clearing your browser data wipes a guest game.
strings.account.sheet.carryOver: Your 18+ check and {terms} consent come with you. See the {privacy}.
strings.account.sheet.preparing: Getting your guest game ready to save…
strings.account.sheet.unavailable: Accounts aren't set up on this version of the game. Your progress is saved on this device.
strings.account.sheet.offlineNow: You're offline. Your game's still saved on this device. Saving to an account needs a connection.
strings.account.sheet.alreadySaved: You're signed in. Your progress saves to your account.
strings.account.email.label: Email
strings.account.email.hint: We only use it to send your link and code. Nobody else sees it.
strings.account.email.sendLogin: Email me a link and code
strings.account.sent.title: Check your inbox
strings.account.sent.save: Link's on the way to {email}. Open it on any device to finish. This game stays put while you do.
strings.account.sent.login: Link and code are on the way to {email}.
strings.account.sent.waiting: Waiting for you to tap the link…
strings.account.code.label: Or type the 6-digit code
strings.account.error.emailInvalid: That email doesn't look right. Check for typos.
strings.account.error.emailExists: That email already has an account.
strings.account.error.notAllowed: That email can't be used here.
strings.account.error.rateLimited: Too many tries. Give it a minute.
strings.account.error.offline: You're offline. Your game's still saved on this device.
strings.account.error.codeInvalid: That code's expired or wrong. Send a new one.
strings.account.error.codeFormat: Type the 6 digits from the email.
strings.account.error.noAccount: No account uses that email yet. Play as a guest, then save your progress to make one.
strings.account.error.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in isn't available right now. Use email.
strings.account.error.identityExists: That Google account is already linked to another player.
strings.account.error.unavailable: Accounts aren't set up on this version of the game.
strings.account.error.other: That didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
strings.account.saved.title: You're saved
strings.account.saved.body: Your progress now rides with your account. Log in on any device to pick it back up.
strings.account.welcomeBack.title: Welcome back
strings.account.welcomeBack.body: You're logged in. Your account's game is on this device now.
strings.account.me.guestBody: Save your progress to keep it on any phone.
strings.account.me.unsent: Some progress hasn't reached your account yet. Sign out anyway?
strings.account.me.signedOutBody: This device isn't saving to any account. Your game here still plays.
strings.account.me.newGuestConfirm: Start over as a new guest? This device's game is replaced with a fresh one. Your account's game stays safe in your account.
strings.account.me.pendingNoEmail: Waiting for you to tap the link in your email…
strings.account.banner.text: That W is worth keeping. Clearing your browser wipes a guest game.
strings.account.callback.title: Clout City
strings.account.callback.expired: That link expired or was already used. Head back and send a new one.
strings.account.callback.invalid: That link isn't complete. Head back and send a new one.
strings.account.callback.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't finish. Head back and try again, or use email.
strings.account.callback.offline: You're offline. Connect, then tap Finish again.
strings.account.callback.unavailable: Accounts aren't set up on this version of the game.
strings.account.welcome.loginIntro: Get your saved game on this device. No account yet? Go back and start playing; you can save any time.
strings.account.nudge.label: Save your progress. Bigger name, same risk: clear your browser and a guest game is gone.
